name: Halaska UI
summary: Single-file React UI kit for AI products: shadcn/ui-parity components plus AI UX patterns and example screens.
description: Halaska UI is a single-file React UI kit for AI products: halaska-kit.jsx installs with curl and needs only react and react-dom — inline styles, no CSS or Tailwind setup, TypeScript definitions in halaska-kit.d.ts, light/dark theming per component. It mirrors the shadcn/ui component set and adds AI-native pieces (Orb, Streaming Text, Thinking Steps, Confidence Bar, Diff views) plus AI UX patterns — prompt input, streaming answer, plan preview, approval card, audit log, error repair — demonstrated on an AI operations agent named Alpha across screens.
contains: single-file React kit: halaska-kit.jsx installed with curl; react + react-dom only, inline styles
~100 styled components and 38 UX patterns per the llms.txt API reference
77 components and 40 AI UX patterns listed on the site
patterns grouped by lifecycle: conversation core, trust, agentic control, output, ambient
AI pieces: Orb, Streaming Text, Thinking Steps, Confidence Bar, Diff views
lifecycle patterns are prop-driven: thinking trace, streaming answer, plan preview, approval card
screens and patterns demo an AI operations agent named Alpha
TypeScript definitions in halaska-kit.d.ts; Geist fonts and keyframes self-inject
